title: thymus serpyllum subsp. richardii
intro: Thymus serpyllum subsp. richardii, commonly known as Wild Thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus serpyllum plant, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Wild Thyme include acting as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can contribute to its use in treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum subsp. richardii include compounds like thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
